features.name: downtown skyscraper cluster
features.notes: Dominant tall structures downtown, visible across the city; 15 to 50+ floors.
features.quote: Tall towers (15-50+ floors) with glass curtain wall facades

features.name: glass tower facades
features.notes: Curtain walls with patterned window grids and antenna spikes.
features.quote: glass curtain wall facades, window patterns, and antenna/spikes on top

features.name: dense city block grid
features.notes: Built-up ground rather than scattered individual buildings.
features.quote: a dense city block grid of mid-rise buildings

features.name: mid rise buildings
features.notes: 3-10 floors; varied colors in grays, browns, and muted blues.

features.name: varied building facades
features.notes: Brick, concrete, and glass facade materials; visible windows and ground-floor doors.
features.quote: some brick, some concrete, some glass facades

features.name: street grid
features.notes: Threads the whole city with varying street widths.
features.quote: Vary between one-way streets, two-way streets, and multi-lane avenues

features.name: wide multi lane avenues
features.notes: Wider than other streets; suited to long street-level views.

features.name: curbed raised sidewalks
features.notes: Along street edges, slightly raised above road level with curb details.
features.quote: Pedestrian paths along the edges of streets, slightly raised from road level, with curb details

features.name: neon facade signs
features.notes: Bright pink, cyan, red, and yellow; concentrated on lower floors and rooftops, with some vertical edge signs.
features.quote: Glowing neon signs and billboards on building facades

features.name: mixed street light poles
features.notes: Lining streets and sidewalks; mix warm orange sodium-vapor and cool white LED, including roadway and pedestrian-scale lights.
features.quote: Street light poles lining the streets and sidewalks

features.name: neon avenue vistas
features.notes: Street-level views down avenues framed by neon-lit facades and receding towers.
features.quote: street-level views looking down the avenues, framed by neon-lit facades and receding towers
